facts.fact: 风暴登陆前背两支步枪去猎场
facts.anchor: lugged two rifles to the hunting grounds

facts.fact: Gazzie 给她 Ida 晚年用的温彻斯特（非杀 Ironheart 那支）
facts.anchor: not the one Ida used to kill Ironheart
“This way,” she said, gesturing to our right.

facts.fact: 她拍死蚊子把血抹在手臂上
facts.anchor: I slapped a mosquito, smearing blood across my forearm.

facts.fact: Gazzie 指向下游三十英尺并嘘声
facts.anchor: point thirty or so feet downstream

facts.fact: 蚊群落在她身上似在藏鳄
facts.anchor: like they were trying to hide the alligator

facts.fact: 野猪盯着他们、 curved tusks
facts.anchor: A pair of intelligent black eyes glared back.
A squeal erupted from the bushes, and the hog rushed out.

facts.fact: Gazzie 从她身后开枪、子弹擦过臀部
facts.anchor: a bullet zipped past my hip

facts.fact: 短吻鳄冲出水面扑向 Gazzie、她绊倒、叙述者开枪
facts.anchor: I raised the rifle in the alligator’s general direction and shot.

facts.fact: Gazzie 扑住鳄背合住双颚
facts.anchor: Gazzie tackled it from behind and held its jaws shut.

facts.fact: Gazzie 从腰间抽出大刀递给她
facts.anchor: pulled a large knife from her belt, flipped it open, and held it out
Reaching around the alligator’s throat, I plunged in the knife and pulled.

facts.fact: Gazzie 手伸进鳄喉再按在她脸上
Gazzie 掏血抹脸、声音失真说话、叙述者呕吐
facts.anchor: I turned to the side and threw up.
